title: Jenkins
subtitle: An extensible automation server for building, testing and delivering software.

tiles.label: SCM triggers
tiles.says: Webhooks start pipelines on every push or pull request.
tiles.detail: Immediate feedback shortens the loop between a change and its verdict.

tiles.label: Controller
tiles.says: The controller schedules, stores config and manages credentials.
tiles.detail: It queues builds and delegates the work, keeping state in one place.

tiles.label: Agents
tiles.says: Ephemeral agents execute stages in clean workspaces.
tiles.detail: Container or pod agents scale on demand and keep builds reproducible.

tiles.label: Build & test
tiles.says: Build and unit tests gate every change.
tiles.detail: Fast failure stops broken code early.

tiles.label: Quality & security
tiles.says: Static analysis and image scans enforce quality gates.
tiles.detail: Vulnerabilities and code smells are blocked before release, lowering risk.

tiles.label: Shared libraries
tiles.says: Shared libraries reuse pipeline code across teams.
tiles.detail: Standard stages keep hundreds of repositories consistent.

tiles.label: Artifacts
tiles.says: Versioned artifacts are pushed to registries.
tiles.detail: Immutable, traceable builds link every deployment to a commit.

tiles.label: Deploy
tiles.says: Deploy stages update environments or GitOps repositories.
tiles.detail: Automated promotion with approvals makes releases routine.

tiles.label: Smoke tests
tiles.detail: Automated verification triggers rollback before customers notice.

declarations: Pipelines are code, stored beside the application.
Agents are disposable; the controller is precious.
Every deployment traces back to a commit.
